description: This file defines a FastAPI router for the /api/v1/schedule endpoint, providing a unified schedule view that combines workouts, trainer bookings, and class sessions for an authenticated user. It includes models, dependency injections, and the main endpoint logic for fetching, filtering, and paginating schedule items.

classes.name: ScheduleItemOut
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a normalized schedule item for API responses, including type, id, start/end datetime, title, and optional status.

methods.name: None _validate_role_or_raise(role: str)
methods.description: Checks if the user role is among allowed roles ('member', 'trainer', 'admin') and raises an HTTP 403 error if not.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict[str,Any]],int] _paginate(items: List[Dict[str, Any]], page: int, page_size: int)
methods.description: Implements pagination over a list of items based on page number and page size.

methods.name: List[ScheduleItemOut] get_schedule( start_from: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Include items with end >= start_from"), end_before: Optional[datetime] = Query(None, description="Include items with start <= end_before"), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number (1-based)"), page_size: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Items per page"), db=Depends(get_db), current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Main API endpoint that retrieves a combined list of schedule items (workouts, bookings, classes) for the current user, applying optional date filters and pagination.

ctags.pattern: /^def _paginate(items: List[Dict[str, Any]], page: int, page_size: int) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, An/
